info.title: API.SH: John Lewis
info.description: The John Lewis API from API.SH: public John Lewis data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Products of one John Lewis category (browse page) with the same fields, sorts and facets as search. 72 products a page. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/johnlewis-category

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A johnlewis.com category that lists products: a /browse/…/_/N-… link, a leaf category link such as …/kettles/c600001693, or its c-number. Department landing pages (e.g. Electricals) are not product lists and answer 404.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: relevance (default), popularity, price_asc, price_desc, discount, newest.

get.description:
One John Lewis product: name, brand, description, price range and price history, offers, rating, breadcrumbs, attributes (specifications), delivery and collection options, and every variant (colour/size) with its sku, product code, price, availability, pre-order state, images, barcodes, energy label, guarantees and protection plans. Use a variant's `sku` and `product_code` with /johnlewis/v1/store-stock.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/johnlewis-product

parameters.description: Product number (e.g. 3310302) or a johnlewis.com product link ending /p3310302.

get.description:
Reviews of one John Lewis product with rating, title, text, date, reviewer name and location, verified-buyer flag, helpful votes, sub-ratings (quality, value…) and photos; plus the rating distribution, sub-rating averages and all review photos. Sort, star filter and text search as on the product page. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/johnlewis-reviews

parameters.description: Product number (e.g. 3310302) or a product link.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: newest (default), highest_rating, lowest_rating, most_useful, with_media.

get.description:
John Lewis (UK) product search with every sort and facet the shop offers. Each product has its id, link, name, brand, price and price range across variants, price history (reductions), offers, rating and review count, colour swatches (sku, link, image, availability), stock flags (out of stock, in-store only, outlet), main attributes and images. `facets` lists every facet with value ids (pass them as `facets`), `did_you_mean` the shop's suggestions. 72 products a page. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/johnlewis-search

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: relevance (default), popularity, price_asc, price_desc, discount, newest.

parameters.name: facets
parameters.description: Facet value ids from `facets` (comma-separated), e.g. 1z141il for the brand John Lewis.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
